evidence_titles: 建模交易平台 CGTrader：AI 生成的 3D 模型数量激增，但销售额仅占 1%
evidence_summaries: IT之家 8 月 17 日消息，随着“图生 3D 模型”AI 工具逐步流行，目前许多 3D 建模交易平台都遭到各种 AI 生成的 3D 模型“轰炸”，不过参考 CGTrader 报告显示，尽管此类 AI 内容正在平台上快速增加，但相关商品的实际销售情况却并未同步增长。 IT之家参考报告获悉，目前 CGTrader 平台约有六分之一的新上架商品由 AI 生成， 不过相应商品的销售表现却十分有限，其销售额仅占平台总销售额的 1% 左右 。 从 CGTrader 的调查结果来看， 质量正是买家拒绝 AI 生成商品的主要原因 。调查显示，只有约 5% 的买家对自己购买的 AI 生成资源感到满意，而整体用户中仅有 4% 认为 AI 生成内容“效果很好”。 这也意味着， 尽管 AI 生成的 3D 模型数量正在迅速增加，但供给增长并没有转化为相应的市场需求 。对于需要特定用途的 3D 资源而言，用户显然仍然更加关注模型的实际质量、可用性以及是否符合项目要求。 ▲ AI 生成的 3D 模型 类似情况并非 CGTrader 独有。近年来，各大互联网平台一方面投入大量资金推动 AI 生成内容的发展，另一方面又不得不不断清理低质量的 AI 生成内容。随着所谓“AI 垃圾内容”大量涌入网络，平台如何在扩大 AI 应用与维持内容质量之间取得平衡，正在成为越来越明显的问题。 更重要的是，AI 生成内容数量的增长并不意味着商业价值也会同步增长。CGTrader 的数据显示，大量 AI 商品进入市场后，真正愿意为其付费的消费者仍然非常有限。这也从另一个角度说明，AI 生成内容能否形成长期、稳定的商业模式，仍然需要市场进一步验证。

worth_tracking.social_original_text:
On tokens and prices per token.

I said I’d write more about this, so here goes: an OpenAI token != another model’s token. We compare AI prices in dollars per million tokens as if a token were a standardized unit, like a gram or a kilowatt-hour. It isn’t. Different models use and produce the exact same text using different numbers of tokens, which means a lower price per token does not necessarily mean a lower bill.

Imagine two identical pizzas. One is cut into 8 slices at $2 each. The other is cut into 16 slices at $1.25 each. The second place advertises cheaper slices, but the whole pizza costs $20 instead of $16. Bummer ... your stomach doesn't actually care about the number of slices you just ate.

I know you are hungry now, but back to tokens. In one small comparison spanning English, technical, multilingual, and numerical text, the tokenizer we use for GPT-5.6 Sol used 766 tokens versus an estimated 1,170 for Claude Opus 5. That's a very significant difference of about 34.5% fewer tokens. You can get the same exact text, but pay for all those extra tokens. The price per token doesn't really tell this story.

Even correcting for tokenizer differences misses the bigger point. What actually matters is price per successful outcome, and for that you can use benchmarks as a starting point, but really you have to try it and measure on your own use cases.

That's all. May the tokens flow.

industry_views.social_original_text:
On tokens and prices per token.

I said I’d write more about this, so here goes: an OpenAI token != another model’s token. We compare AI prices in dollars per million tokens as if a token were a standardized unit, like a gram or a kilowatt-hour. It isn’t. Different models use and produce the exact same text using different numbers of tokens, which means a lower price per token does not necessarily mean a lower bill.

Imagine two identical pizzas. One is cut into 8 slices at $2 each. The other is cut into 16 slices at $1.25 each. The second place advertises cheaper slices, but the whole pizza costs $20 instead of $16. Bummer ... your stomach doesn't actually care about the number of slices you just ate.

I know you are hungry now, but back to tokens. In one small comparison spanning English, technical, multilingual, and numerical text, the tokenizer we use for GPT-5.6 Sol used 766 tokens versus an estimated 1,170 for Claude Opus 5. That's a very significant difference of about 34.5% fewer tokens. You can get the same exact text, but pay for all those extra tokens. The price per token doesn't really tell this story.

Even correcting for tokenizer differences misses the bigger point. What actually matters is price per successful outcome, and for that you can use benchmarks as a starting point, but really you have to try it and measure on your own use cases.

That's all. May the tokens flow.

evidence_titles: 建模交易平台 CGTrader：AI 生成的 3D 模型数量激增，但销售额仅占 1%
evidence_summaries: IT之家 8 月 17 日消息，随着“图生 3D 模型”AI 工具逐步流行，目前许多 3D 建模交易平台都遭到各种 AI 生成的 3D 模型“轰炸”，不过参考 CGTrader 报告显示，尽管此类 AI 内容正在平台上快速增加，但相关商品的实际销售情况却并未同步增长。 IT之家参考报告获悉，目前 CGTrader 平台约有六分之一的新上架商品由 AI 生成， 不过相应商品的销售表现却十分有限，其销售额仅占平台总销售额的 1% 左右 。 从 CGTrader 的调查结果来看， 质量正是买家拒绝 AI 生成商品的主要原因 。调查显示，只有约 5% 的买家对自己购买的 AI 生成资源感到满意，而整体用户中仅有 4% 认为 AI 生成内容“效果很好”。 这也意味着， 尽管 AI 生成的 3D 模型数量正在迅速增加，但供给增长并没有转化为相应的市场需求 。对于需要特定用途的 3D 资源而言，用户显然仍然更加关注模型的实际质量、可用性以及是否符合项目要求。 ▲ AI 生成的 3D 模型 类似情况并非 CGTrader 独有。近年来，各大互联网平台一方面投入大量资金推动 AI 生成内容的发展，另一方面又不得不不断清理低质量的 AI 生成内容。随着所谓“AI 垃圾内容”大量涌入网络，平台如何在扩大 AI 应用与维持内容质量之间取得平衡，正在成为越来越明显的问题。 更重要的是，AI 生成内容数量的增长并不意味着商业价值也会同步增长。CGTrader 的数据显示，大量 AI 商品进入市场后，真正愿意为其付费的消费者仍然非常有限。这也从另一个角度说明，AI 生成内容能否形成长期、稳定的商业模式，仍然需要市场进一步验证。

evidence_summaries: IT之家 8 月 17 日消息，软银集团（SoftBank Group Corp.）近日向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交文件，披露了其最新持仓情况。文件显示，软银新建仓美国金融公司 Capital One，同时在今年第二季度出售了其持有的台积电（TSMC）约 71.5% 的股份。 根据规定，包括财富管理机构、捐赠基金、养老基金、对冲基金等在内的机构投资者，都必须向美国证券监管机构提交季度持仓报告，披露截至每个自然季度末所持有的股票。 截至最新季度末，也就是 6 月 30 日，软银披露其持有 276,811 股 Capital One 股票，持仓市值约为 5,550 万美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 3.75 亿元人民币） 。 同一季度，软银还买入了 Life360 的 10,718 股股票。Life360 是一家提供基于 GPS 的位置共享服务的公司，软银披露的这笔持仓价值约 48.85 万美元 （现汇率约合 330.3 万元人民币） 。 与此同时，软银还披露，2026 年第二季度出售了约 140 万股台积电股票，占其此前所持台积电股份的 71.5%，套现金额约为 2.698 亿美元 （现汇率约合 18.24 亿元人民币） 。

items.brief: OpenAI 研究员 Thibault Sottiaux 发文指出，不同模型的 token 不等价，每 token 价格低不代表总成本低，真正应比较每次成功结果的价格。
items.social_original_text:
On tokens and prices per token.

I said I’d write more about this, so here goes: an OpenAI token != another model’s token. We compare AI prices in dollars per million tokens as if a token were a standardized unit, like a gram or a kilowatt-hour. It isn’t. Different models use and produce the exact same text using different numbers of tokens, which means a lower price per token does not necessarily mean a lower bill.

Imagine two identical pizzas. One is cut into 8 slices at $2 each. The other is cut into 16 slices at $1.25 each. The second place advertises cheaper slices, but the whole pizza costs $20 instead of $16. Bummer ... your stomach doesn't actually care about the number of slices you just ate.

I know you are hungry now, but back to tokens. In one small comparison spanning English, technical, multilingual, and numerical text, the tokenizer we use for GPT-5.6 Sol used 766 tokens versus an estimated 1,170 for Claude Opus 5. That's a very significant difference of about 34.5% fewer tokens. You can get the same exact text, but pay for all those extra tokens. The price per token doesn't really tell this story.

Even correcting for tokenizer differences misses the bigger point. What actually matters is price per successful outcome, and for that you can use benchmarks as a starting point, but really you have to try it and measure on your own use cases.

That's all. May the tokens flow.
